text:
sara_pm: Heads-up: proposing a per-tenant progressive rollout for dual-write routing (legacy -> new-path). Goal: minimize blast radius for enterprise customers while validating correctness and billing parity. Need ops + infra checklist.
devin_eng: high level plan?
sara_pm: shadow -> per-tenant opt-in for 3 pilot tenants -> automated ramp of pilot tenants from 0% to 100% over 48h -> staged global ramp but with tenant isolation and per-tenant rollback. Manual global gate.
rachel_sre: Add safety: require 24h stable telemetry per pilot tenant before enabling auto-ramp. Abort if any tenant shows >0.4% increase in user-facing errors or p99 latency +75ms.
marco_platform: Flag model: `dual_write_v2` with attributes: `tenant_mode: [opt-in, opt-out, enforced]`, `per_tenant_pct`, `global_pct`, `auto_ramp_window_hours`, `shadow_mode`. We'll expose a per-tenant API to toggle.
devin_eng: For correctness: dual-write means writes go to both paths, reads served from legacy until cutover. We'll run a divergence checker job comparing write sets with a tolerance window. If divergence > 0.1% for a tenant, that tenant is paused.
sara_pm: Pass criteria for pilots: data divergence <=0.05%, billing tokens delta < 3%, no CS tickets flagged within 48h.
marco_platform: config example (YAML):
```yaml
flag: dual_write_v2
per_tenant_mode: enabled
pilot_tenants: [acct-501, acct-803, acct-210]
stages:
  - name: shadow
    mode: shadow
    duration_h: 6
  - name: pilot
    mode: dual-write
    tenant_pct: 100
    duration_h: 48
  - name: global_ramp
    mode: dual-write
    global_pct: 10
    auto_ramp_window_hours: 24
abort_conditions:
  - expr: "tenant_divergence_pct > 0.1"
  - expr: "user_error_delta_pct > 0.4"
  - expr: "p99_latency_delta_ms > 75"
manual_gate_after: pilot
```
devin_eng: instrumentation checklist: emit `dualwrite.drift_count`, `dualwrite.drift_pct`, `dualwrite.latency_ms`, `dualwrite.cost_delta_pct`. Traces should include `dw.tenant` and `dw.trace_id` to tie divergence to specific requests.
rachel_sre: alerts: Pager if drift_pct > 0.1% for any tenant for 10m OR if user_error_delta_pct > 0.4% aggregated. Otherwise notify #sre-review. Also monitor queue depth; if it increases >15% for 5m, pause auto-ramp.
sara_pm: Customer communication: pilot tenants will be contacted pre-rollout. Template: "We're testing an improved routing path. You'll be added to pilot cohort. If you notice anomalies, reply and we'll opt you out immediately"
marco_platform: We'll add `tenant_opt_out_reason` metadata and store audit logs. Also adding a forced-rollforward endpoint for support to flip a tenant to legacy if needed.
devin_eng: Test plan: unit tests, shadow run for 6h, automated divergence job with synthetic golden dataset, e2e smoke for tenant-scoped traffic. We'll run synthetic checks against each pilot tenant every 15m.
rachel_sre: Ops playbook: if a pilot tenant fails, triage steps: 1) pause auto-ramp for that tenant, 2) run divergence report, 3) if severe, flip tenant to legacy and open incident. Create incident if >1 tenant impacted or if global auto-ramp has already started.
rollout-bot: Draft flag created: dual_write_v2 by marco_platform. Runbook link (internal): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dual-write-v2 (request perms).
sara_pm: schedule: shadow tonight 23:30 UTC for 6h. Pilot tenants started tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Auto-ramp window set to 48h for pilots. Global ramp earliest next Tue post manual gate.
devin_eng: edge case: cache invalidation and idempotency. We'll add an idempotency probe and a cache-coherence check. Abort if repeated idempotency errors >0.05% per tenant.
rachel_sre: Also check billing parity: if cost delta > 5% for a tenant we alert finance and pause.
marco_platform: Implemented per-tenant audit logs and will seed pilot tenant list. Adding `support.force_legacy` endpoint protected by RBAC.
sara_pm: owners: sara_pm (PM), devin_eng (eng lead), rachel_sre (oncall), marco_platform (flag infra). PM signoff required before global gate.
sara_pm: I'll post the pilot customer note after shadow completes and thread back here with results.
devin_eng: starting shadow prep now.
rachel_sre: I'll standby for oncall.
rollout-bot: Reminder scheduled: 1777773580 -> shadow run start.
sara_pm: closing thread for now unless blockers. Thanks all :handshake:
